data.name: Omniscient
data.detailed_description:
Your senses define reality. Without them, you're either dead - or you perceive something else entirely.

Rely on your enhanced sight and sound abilities to evade an alien entity that actively hunts you. Sharpen your sight to see it through walls and doors. Focus your hearing to track where it stalks. Or you won't know it's coming.

The entity hunts in a way you can't expect. It goes silent. It disappears. It relocates. And it can change its own form without warning. Once you're detected, there's no escaping it.

Designs inspired by 70s and 80s retrofuturism. Navigate the maze-like corridors of your ship, through blind corners and passages built to disorient. With cold metal surrounding you, there is little room for respite.

Your team's mission was to investigate The Waveform - a shapeshifting signal that seemed to originate from Neptune. Though they've vanished, you still have OAI, your ship's superintelligence. With its guidance, you can find out what happened to them. And unravel the truth behind the Waveform, that drew humanity so far from home.

Omniscient is a focused cosmic horror experience, completable in a single sitting. Start from the lowest level of the ship and reach the top. Scattered logs and entries left behind reveal the bigger picture, for those willing to seek it.

data.short_description: Omniscient is a first person horror set aboard a research ship drifting in Neptune's orbit. Your crew is gone. The power is out. And something else lurked onboard. Unarmed and alone, trust your newly enhanced senses to survive. They are your greatest gifts, after all.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti / AMD Radeon equivalent (11GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Uses Software Lumen (ray tracing hardware not required)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / RTX 3060 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: N/A

content_descriptors.notes: Omniscient is a psychological horror game containing non-graphic violence and death. Players may be caught and killed by a hostile entity throughout the game, depicted through a brief death sequence without explicit blood or gore. Later in the game, the player's objective involves killing a humanoid figure, conveyed primarily through sound design rather than graphic visuals. The game also includes unsettling imagery and themes of psychological distress and body horror.
